scope: ABI 1 translated private-BAR1 writes followed, only after all peer results, by one CPU write to each same RM-managed BAR1 allocation.
redaction: The published driver uses fictional GPU UUIDs; the private executed module hash is preserved separately and is not expected from the redacted source.
limitations: CPU BAR1 controls are host-route controls and are not P2P transfers.
A writable host BAR1 opening does not prove correct GPU-originated routing.
The four-byte raw-command run has no CUPTI or physical TLP trace.
